en_title: Mass Effect TV Series Remains Active at Prime Video Despite BioWare Closure
cn_title: BioWare关闭，《质量效应》剧集仍在开发
subtitle: 荧屏未来尚存
opus_summary: IGN独家获悉，BioWare关闭后，《质量效应》剧集仍在开发，原有创作团队也全部留任。故事将设定在游戏原三部曲之后，曾计划于2026年第四季度开拍，目前尚无播出日期。

paragraphs.en: The Mass Effect video game franchise may have come to an end with the shocking demise of BioWare , but IGN can exclusively reveal that its future on the small screen remains possible. Sources inside Prime Video have confirmed that the Mass Effect television series remains in development at Amazon MGM Studios.
paragraphs.cn: BioWare遭遇令人震惊的变故后，《质量效应》游戏系列或许已告一段落，但IGN独家获悉，该系列仍有望登陆小荧幕。Prime Video内部消息人士向IGN确认，Amazon MGM Studios仍在开发《质量效应》电视剧。

paragraphs.en: Our source added that, as of now, all the creatives who were attached to the TV project remain onboard.
paragraphs.cn: 消息人士还补充说，目前所有参与该剧创作的人员都仍在项目中。

paragraphs.en: As of August 2025, Doug Jung (Mindhunter, Star Trek Beyond) was serving as showrunner with Daniel Casey (Fast & Furious 9) writing the series. The production team also included Jessica Jones executive producer Karim Zreik, BioWare's Mass Effect boss Mike Gamble, and former Marvel Studios boss Ari Arad.
paragraphs.cn: 截至2025年8月，Doug Jung（《心灵猎人》《星际迷航3：超越星辰》）担任剧集运作人，Daniel Casey（《速度与激情9》）负责编剧。制作团队还包括《杰西卡·琼斯》执行制片人Karim Zreik、BioWare《质量效应》项目负责人Mike Gamble，以及漫威影业前负责人Ari Arad。

paragraphs.en: The Mass Effect TV series has officially been in development at Prime Video since 2024 , although it was first rumored back in 2021 after years of failed attempts to realize the sci-fi game franchise as a feature film .
paragraphs.cn: 《质量效应》电视剧自2024年起正式由Prime Video开发，不过早在2021年便有传闻称该项目正在筹备。此前，多年来曾有多次尝试，想将这款科幻游戏系列改编成电影，但均未成功。

paragraphs.en: We learned last year that the show won’t retread Commander Shepard’s origin story from the games and will instead be set after the original trilogy.
paragraphs.cn: 我们去年获悉，该剧不会重讲游戏中薛帕德指挥官的起源故事，而是将故事设定在原三部曲之后。

paragraphs.en: Daniel Casey took to social media this past April to shoot down reports that Prime Video wanted rewrites to make the show more appealing to a non-gaming audience .
paragraphs.cn: 今年4月，Daniel Casey在社交媒体上驳斥了有关Prime Video要求重写剧本、以吸引非游戏玩家观众的报道。

paragraphs.en: The Mass Effect TV series had, at one point, been eyeing a Q4 2026 production start , but it remains without a release date as of time of this story’s publication.
paragraphs.cn: 《质量效应》电视剧曾计划于2026年第四季度开拍，但截至本文发布时，仍未公布播出日期。

paragraphs.en: Given the success of their Fallout TV series adaptation, Prime Video was reportedly hoping to capture lightning in a bottle twice with a Mass Effect show. IGN will keep you up to date on any further developments we learn.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，鉴于《辐射》改编剧的成功，Prime Video希望凭借《质量效应》剧集再创佳绩。IGN将持续跟进后续消息。

paragraphs.en: In the meantime, read how the Internet reacted to the cancellation of Mass Effect 5 and the death of BioWare and our thoughts about how Mass Effect 5 was supposed to redeem the series after Andromeda (and now we’ll never get that).
paragraphs.cn: 在此期间，不妨看看网友对《质量效应5》取消开发和BioWare关闭的反应，以及我们对《质量效应5》原本应如何在《质量效应：仙女座》之后挽回系列声誉的看法（如今，我们再也等不到了）。

paragraphs.en: Jim Vejvoda (he/him) is IGN's Assoc. Director of Entertainment Content.
paragraphs.cn: Jim Vejvoda（人称代词为he／him）是IGN娱乐内容副总监。
